exact_normal_execution_proof.function_object: At import, let F be the function object bound to _reset_stars.  The assignment binds _initial_reset_stars to the same F.  With no research-harness monkeypatch, both global names remain bound to F.
exact_normal_execution_proof.h1_dispatch: The renamed H1 call therefore invokes the identical F once with the identical evaluated positional arguments and identical return unpacking.
exact_normal_execution_proof.recursive_dispatch: The recursive call remains textually and operationally unchanged and invokes F once per recursive reset.
exact_normal_execution_proof.normal_path_prediction_bytes: EXACTLY_IDENTICAL_BY_SAME_FUNCTION_OBJECT_AND_SAME_ARGUMENT_ORDER; a later source audit must verify the frozen diff satisfies these premises
exact_normal_execution_proof.probe_only_difference: After import, a target-free research harness may replace module._reset_stars while module._initial_reset_stars retains F.  H1 then bypasses the recursive observer and the recursive call remains observable.
